subject.title: fix(dreaming): drop heartbeat assistant responses from dream corpus

question: Should this fix be explicitly forward-only for existing Dreaming data, or should upgrades perform a one-time rebaseline of Dreaming-only corpus and ingestion state?
rationale: Old transcripts cannot be authenticated with the new provenance marker, while automatically discarding or rebuilding derived memory state has user-visible retention consequences that should not be selected by automation.

options.title: Forward-only with bounded expiry
options.body: Preserve existing state, document that historical artifacts are not retroactively cleaned, and prove new pollution stops while old corpus entries age out through the configured lookback.

options.title: Rebaseline Dreaming state
options.body: Add a tested version transition that clears or rebaselines only Dreaming-derived corpus and ingestion state without deleting canonical transcripts or trusting prompt text.

recommendation.title: Forward-only with bounded expiry
recommendation.body: Preserve existing state, document that historical artifacts are not retroactively cleaned, and prove new pollution stops while old corpus entries age out through the configured lookback.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history connects this owner to both the provenance contract and recent memory-host behavior, making them the best available router for the upgrade semantics choice.
